title: Calcium–albumin interaction adds no clear frozen prediction gain for grip strength across two NHANES cycles
abstract: A source-centered total calcium × albumin interaction had target weighted MSE gain 0.021724 kg² (95% target-PSU interval -0.076395 to 0.133665) over flexible marginal chemistry and demographic predictors in 4,582 NHANES 2013–14 adults; no clear incremental benefit was established. Source 2011–12 cross-validation also failed to improve; adding nonlinear corrected calcium to the comparator reversed the target point gain. This negative functional prediction test is not an ionized-calcium assay validation.
